frequency.docs:
**frequency**: The frequency to run the PWM with. Lower frequencies have more visual artifacts, but can represent much more colors. Defaults to `1kHz`.

*See also: [Zephyr PWM Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/zephyr_pwm#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this output component.

*See also: [Zephyr PWM Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/zephyr_pwm#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin to use PWM on.

*See also: [Zephyr PWM Output](https://esphome.io/components/output/zephyr_pwm#configuration-variables)*
